lines.en: label wakanadate25p3:
scene wakanatreatsyou1
After a fair bit of walking and a great deal of being told where to go, the two of us make it to a rather...{i}purple{/i} looking restaurant.
lines.zh: 走了一段不短的路、又被指挥了无数次方向之后，我俩总算到了一家看起来相当……{i}紫{/i}的餐厅。

lines.en: And not a moment too late, as I was only a block or two from tossing Wakana into the river to never be heard from again.
lines.zh: 而且来得正是时候——再晚一两个街区，我就要把 Wakana 扔进河里，让她永远消失。

lines.en: In fact, the only reason I {i}didn’t{/i} do such a thing is that I didn’t want to be bothered actually navigating to it.
lines.zh: 事实上，我{i}没{/i}这么干的唯一理由，是我不想费劲真的找到那条河。

lines.en: Though, I suppose there’s the element of a free dinner that I was looking forward to as well.
lines.zh: 不过我想，还有一顿免费晚餐这个我也挺期待的因素。

lines.en: But either way, we’re here now and I no longer have to deal with the tyranny that is backseat driver, Wakana Watabe.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，我们到了，我也不用再忍受渡部 Wakana 这个「后座司机」的暴政了。

lines.en: And yes, it is possible to be a backseat driver when the seat is literally someone’s back.
lines.zh: 对，当那个座位字面上就是某个人的背时，也完全可以当后座司机。

lines.en: And yes, it is just as annoying as it sounds.
lines.zh: 对，而且就跟听起来一样烦人。

lines.en: : Is something wrong {i}again,{/i} Arakawa? What did I do to piss you off this time?
lines.zh: : {i}又{/i}怎么了，荒川？这次我干了什么惹你生气？

lines.en: : This time isn’t serious. I just think you need to be a little more considerate when someone is carrying you around. You were very bossy back there.
lines.zh: : 这次不严重。我只是觉得别人背着你的時候你该体贴一点。你刚才太颐指气使了。

lines.en: : Aww...did I hurt your feelings? Does it make you feel weak not being in charge of every facet of everyone’s life at every point ever?
lines.zh: : 哎呀……我伤到你感情了？不能随时随地掌控每个人生活的每个方面，是不是让你觉得很虚弱？

lines.en: : Wakana, I was literally carrying you.
lines.zh: : Wakana，我当时可是字面意义上在背着你。

lines.en: : And you could have done a better job. That is all I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 而你本可以做得更好。我要说的就这些。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou2
: But we made it here. And I suppose that’s all that really matters.
lines.zh: : 可我们到了。我想这才是最重要的。

lines.en: : Until you have to find another human taxi once we’re done eating. Also, where is {i}here?{/i} And since when does something like this exist in Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 直到吃完饭你还得再找一辆人类出租车。还有，{i}这儿{/i}是哪儿？以及 Kumon-mi 什么时候有这种地方了？

lines.en: : This place has existed forever. You likely just haven’t stumbled upon it because you’re an overly-sensitive manchild who spends his free time eating at maid cafes and hitting on teenagers.
lines.zh: : 这地方一直都在。你大概只是没撞上过，因为你是个过度敏感的巨婴，空闲时间都花在女仆咖啡厅吃饭和撩未成年少女上。

lines.en: : Only because it’s impossible to do that first thing without doing the second thing in the process.
lines.zh: : 只是因为干第一件事的时候不可能不顺带干第二件。

lines.en: : It is very much possible to visit a maid cafe without being a pervert, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 去女仆咖啡厅而不当变态，是完全可能的，荒川。

lines.en: : Well, it isn’t possible for me. And the food there is surprisingly good.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对我来说不可能。而且那儿的食物意外地好吃。

lines.en: : That’s just not the reason you go.
lines.zh: : 那不是你去的理由。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou3
: This place has been a favorite spot of mine since college. I’ve come here with Osako on many occasions. We even had our first date here.
lines.zh: : 这地方从大学起就是我最喜欢的店。我跟 Osako 来过很多次。我们第一次约会就在这儿。

lines.en: : And now {i}I{/i} get to have the pleasure of being wined and dined by you in the same building where you formed a lifelong partnership? Wow. Maybe we really {i}are{/i} friends after all?
lines.zh: : 而现在，{i}我{/i}有幸在同一个你建立起终身伴侣关系的地方，被你请吃请喝？哇。也许我们{i}真的{/i}是朋友了？

lines.en: : I’m glad to see my decision to share a bit of sentimentality with you is paying off in spades. Just don’t mention we came here to Osako or she’ll likely assume we’re sleeping together.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到我跟你分享一点感伤的回报如此丰厚。只是别跟 Osako 提我们来过这儿，不然她大概会以为我们上床了。

lines.en: : That said, is it actually okay for me {i}to{/i} be here? You could have just taken me to a McDonald’s or something.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我{i}来这儿{/i}真的行吗？你本来可以直接带我去个麦当劳什么的。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou4
: We’re here because {i}I{/i} want to be here. Not because you actually mean something to me.
lines.zh: : 我们来这儿是因为{i}我{/i}想来。不是因为你对我真有什么意义。

lines.en: : That’s fine. Just make sure to give me a five-star review for the ride. It’ll look good on my profile.
lines.zh: : 没关系。只要记得给这趟车程打个五星好评。会让我的主页好看点。

lines.en: : Did you know you’re the first person I’ve ever brought here {i}besides{/i} Osako?
lines.zh: : 你知道你是{i}除{/i} Osako {i}之外{/i}我第一个带到这儿来的人吗？

lines.en: : No. But that’s mostly due to the fact that the only things I know about you are that you’re into BDSM and that your back is fucked up. Which, thinking about it now, isn’t the safest combination of things.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过这主要是因为关于你我只知道两件事：你玩 BDSM，还有你的背有问题。现在想想，这两样组合起来可不太安全。

lines.en: : I’ve managed so far. Albeit with a great deal of help from the medical field.
lines.zh: : 我撑到现在了。虽然很大程度上靠了医学界的帮助。

lines.en: : But what I’m trying to allude to in telling you this seemingly unimportant fact is that this gesture is meant to make you smile.
lines.zh: : 但我告诉你这个看似无关紧要的事实，是想暗示：这个举动是为了让你笑。

lines.en: : If you even know how, that is.
lines.zh: : 如果你还会笑的话。

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不会。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see you do, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴看到你会。

lines.en: : You’ve been doing that a lot lately, come to think of it.
lines.zh: : 说起来，你最近笑得挺多的。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou5
: It’s almost like getting to know someone means you can show them sides of yourself you don’t typically show others.
lines.zh: : 就好像认识一个人，就意味着你能把自己不常给别人看的那一面给他们看。

lines.en: : Yeah. But only {i}almost.{/i} I’m still going to keep everything hidden forever because it makes life easier.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过只是{i}好像{/i}。我还是打算永远把一切藏起来，因为那样活着轻松。

lines.en: : If your life is so easy, why do your eyes begin to glisten each time I bring up a certain extremely controversial poet?
lines.zh: : 如果你活得那么轻松，为什么每次我提起那位极具争议的诗人，你的眼睛就开始泛光？

lines.en: : My eyes are always glistening. I am simply that beautiful. But not nearly as beautiful as-
lines.zh: : 我的眼睛本来就一直在泛光。我就是这么美。但远不如——

lines.en: : Don’t even think about it.
lines.zh: : 想都别想。

lines.en: : My bad. The whole “being out on a date at an important restaurant” thing must be getting to me.
lines.zh: : 我的错。大概是「在一家重要的餐厅里约会」这件事让我晕了头。

lines.en: : This is not a {i}date,{/i} Arakawa. This is two gloomy and sarcastic friends escaping the grind that is a life dedicated to sculpting the minds of youth. Or, in your case, destroying them.
lines.zh: : 这不是{i}约会{/i}，荒川。这是两个阴沉又爱讽刺的朋友，从塑造青年心灵这份苦差里逃出来喘口气。或者在你这儿，是摧毁它们。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s still {i}sculpting.{/i} Just in reverse.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那也算{i}塑造{/i}。只是方向反了。

lines.en: : You disgust me.
lines.zh: : 你真让我恶心。

lines.en: : Then why are you still smiling?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么还在笑？

lines.en: : Because you’ve forgiven me. And I’m glad that we’re back on track.
lines.zh: : 因为你已经原谅我了。而且我很高兴我们回到正轨了。

lines.en: : Who says I’ve forgiven you?
lines.zh: : 谁说我原谅你了？

lines.en: : You do. Just not directly. But your actions and your attitude tell me that I have crawled my way out of the doghouse and back into your top eight.
lines.zh: : 你说的。只是没直说。但你的行为和态度告诉我，我已经从狗窝里爬出来，回到了你的前八名。

lines.en: : Top eight?
lines.zh: : 前八名？

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou6
: Wait, Arakawa — how old are you again?
lines.zh: : 等等，荒川——你多大了来着？

lines.en: : Did you...{i}not{/i} have a Myspace account growing up?
lines.zh: : 你……小时候{i}没有{/i} Myspace 账号？

lines.en: : Is that a social media thing?
lines.zh: : 那是个社交媒体的东西？

lines.en: : It is, yes. Or...was. Or technically still {i}is.{/i} But mostly just {i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是，是的。或者……曾经是。或者严格说现在{i}还是{/i}。但大体上是{i}曾经{/i}。

lines.en: : Then, no. I was never into that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 那没有。我从来不玩那种东西。

lines.en: : Wow, you really are the most dull person to ever walk the face of the Earth, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇，你真是这地球表面上走过的最无趣的人，是吧？

lines.en: : I guess so. But it’s not like you’re all that far ahead of me, little Miss “Private school.”
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过你也领先不了我多少，「私立学校」小姐。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou7
: Woe is me. I’m being teased for receiving a proper education and coming from an affluent background. Oh, how will I ever recover from this?
lines.zh: : 我真命苦啊。因为受过良好教育、家境优渥而被取笑。哦，我要怎么才能从这打击里恢复过来？

lines.en: : Actually, yeah. Hold on. If you come from an affluent background, why are you living in a one bedroom apartment with a girl who works two jobs?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，等等。既然你出身富裕，为什么还跟一个打两份工的女孩住在一居室里？

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou8
: Arakawa, this may come as a big surprise to you, so brace yourself- but there are people in this world who are too proud to accept aid from others and would much rather get by on their own terms.
lines.zh: : 荒川，接下来说的事可能会让你大吃一惊，做好心理准备——这世上有一些人太骄傲，不肯接受别人的资助，宁愿按自己的方式过日子。

lines.en: : When Osako and I first decided to start living together, we agreed to be among those people. We agreed that we’d survive off of our {i}own{/i} money rather than rely on my parents.
lines.zh: : 我和 Osako 刚开始同居时就约定要做那种人。我们说好靠{i}自己{/i}的钱活下去，而不是依赖我父母。

lines.en: : Because life is more fulfilling that way.
lines.zh: : 因为那样的人生更充实。

lines.en: : Additionally, relying on someone to that extent means you have the potential to be monumentally {i}fucked{/i} if they pull the rug out from underneath you.
lines.zh: : 另外，依赖一个人到那种程度，意味着万一他们抽走了你脚下的地毯，你可能会被搞得{i}惨不忍睹{/i}。

lines.en: : And if I am going to be monumentally {i}fucked{/i} by {i}anyone,{/i} I’d prefer it to be my partner rather than my parents.
lines.zh: : 而如果非要被{i}谁{/i}搞得{i}惨不忍睹{/i}，我宁愿是我的伴侣，而不是我父母。

lines.en: : That’s kind of admirable, actually. I wish I had that kind of willpower.
lines.zh: : 这其实挺让人佩服的。我要有那种意志力就好了。

lines.en: : I wish you had {i}any{/i} amount of willpower so you could come to understand that your insistence on nibbling at forbidden fruit is completely asinine and that you are squandering a wonderful opportunity.
lines.zh: : 我希望你有{i}哪怕一丁点{/i}意志力，好让你明白：你非要啃那颗禁果的执念完全是蠢到家了，而你在糟蹋一个绝好的机会。

lines.en: : Wait, what? Are we changing topics?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？我们换话题了？

lines.en: : No. At the moment, we are on the topic of love. And seeing as my love is strong and my loyalty is unflappable, it is time for me to, once again, take a moment or two to ridicule you.
lines.zh: : 没有。此刻我们的话题是爱。既然我的爱很坚固、我的忠诚不可动摇，那就又到了我花点时间嘲笑你的时刻。

lines.en: : What happened to smiley Wakana? I want her back.
lines.zh: : 那个会笑的 Wakana 去哪儿了？我要她回来。

lines.en: : No. You asked me a question about my personal life, so it’s only fair that I now pry into yours as if my words are the jaws of life and your thoughts are-
lines.zh: : 不。你问了我一个关于我私生活的问题，所以我现在公平地来刺探你的，就像我的话是救生钳、你的思想是——

lines.en: : Choose a different simile.
lines.zh: : 换个比喻。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou9
scene wakanatreatsyou10
: Apologies. I...didn’t realize that was-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我……没意识到那是——

lines.en: : Anyway, what I meant to say is that this dinner means nothing if all we discuss is {i}me.{/i} Relationships go both ways and-
lines.zh: : 总之，我想说的是，如果我们只聊{i}我{/i}，这顿晚饭就没意义了。关系是双向的，而且——

lines.en: : Yours doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 你的不是。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou11
: Was...Was that a lesbian joke?
lines.zh: : 刚……刚才那是女同笑话？

lines.en: : Yeah. Just moving right along. No time for any more depressing stuff right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们继续往下走。现在没时间再说丧气事了。

lines.en: : You {i}do{/i} know I’m attracted to men as well, correct?
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}我也喜欢男人吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. But I also know that Osako {i}isn’t.{/i} Which makes my joke both valid and hilarious.
lines.zh: : 知道。但我也知道 Osako {i}不{/i}喜欢。所以我的笑话既成立又很搞笑。

lines.en: : While it’s cute to see your sense of humor is no more mature than the girls who fill your classroom, I would like to move on now.
lines.zh: : 看到你的幽默感跟你教室里那些女生成熟度相当虽然很可爱，但我想继续往下走了。

lines.en: : My bad. Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 我的错。请讲。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou12
: Arakawa, I am going to be straight with you right now.
lines.zh: : 荒川，我现在要跟你直说。

lines.en: : Get your facts in order, Wakana. You were bi just a second ago.
lines.zh: : 先把事实搞清楚，Wakana。你一秒前还是双性恋。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou13
: Pfft!
: Are...Are you actually-
lines.zh: : 你……你是真的——

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou14
: No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : I am going to be {i}direct{/i} with you right now because this matter concerns me on a number of levels and, as the most successful person you know in the world of romance, you should follow my lead.
lines.zh: : 我现在要对你{i}直说{/i}，因为这件事在好几个层面上都关系到我，而作为你认识的人里在恋爱世界里最成功的那个，你该听我的。

lines.en: : By doing what exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体指做什么？

lines.en: : By cutting down the hopes and dreams of twenty hormonal teenagers who think they’re in love with you because you’re the only creature within a fifty mile radius who has a penis.
lines.zh: : 斩断二十个以为自己爱上了你的荷尔蒙少女的希望和梦想——因为在方圆五十英里内，你是唯一一个有阴茎的生物。

lines.en: : Wakana-
lines.zh: : Wakana——

lines.en: : And by opening your god damn eyes and seeing what’s right in front of you.
lines.zh: : 还有，睁开你他妈的眼睛，看看就在你面前的东西。

lines.en: : What’s right in front of me is a woman who’s already in a committed relationship. And Osako would-
lines.zh: : 在我面前的是一个已经有稳定关系的女人。而且 Osako 会——

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou15
: Not {i}me,{/i} you fucking idiot. Imani.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}我{/i}，你这操蛋的白痴。是 Imani。

lines.en: : You too?
lines.zh: : 你也来？

lines.en: : What do you mean, “me too?” Who else have you talked to about this?
lines.zh: : 「我也来」是什么意思？你还跟谁聊过这个？

lines.en: : Rika. And I’ll tell you the same thing I told her. I care about Imani. Like...way more than I ever expected to.
lines.zh: : Rika。而我要跟你说我跟她说过的同一句话。我在乎 Imani。比……比我预想的多得多。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou16
: Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什——

lines.en: : That {i}is{/i} why.
lines.zh: : {i}就是{/i}因为这样。

lines.en: : I’m not following, Arakawa. Please channel all of the primitive power in your simian brain and explain this to me in a way that a normal human being would be able to understand.
lines.zh: : 我没跟上，荒川。请调动你那猿猴大脑里全部原始的力量，用一个正常人能听懂的方式给我解释一下。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou17
: Imani is a {i}great{/i} match for me. Everyone knows that. And if I were a normal person, I’d jump at the opportunity to be with her.
lines.zh: : Imani 跟我{i}非常{/i}般配。所有人都知道。如果我是个正常人，我会立刻抓住跟她在一起的机会。

lines.en: : But I’m {i}not{/i} a normal person.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}不{/i}是正常人。

lines.en: : And I {i}can’t{/i} be with her in a way that would make her happy.
lines.zh: : 而且我{i}没法{/i}用一种能让她幸福的方式跟她在一起。

lines.en: : She’d grow to resent me when she realizes that I’m not who she thinks I am. And eventually, she’d start blaming herself for not seeing that in the first place.
lines.zh: : 等她发现我不是她以为的那个人，她会开始怨恨我。最终，她会开始责怪自己当初没看出来。

lines.en: : She’s strong and independent and all that, so I don’t want to say it would screw her up for good when I think she’d be fine after a little while.
lines.zh: : 她坚强又独立什么的，所以我不想说那会把她彻底毁掉——我想她过一阵子会没事的。

lines.en: : But {i}I{/i} wouldn’t. I don’t have anyone else like her in my life.
lines.zh: : 但{i}我{/i}不会。我这辈子没有第二个像她这样的人。

lines.en: : There’s you, yeah. But you’re different. Imani’s like...a little sister or something. Just she’s a completely different race than me and I also want to have earth-shattering sex with her.
lines.zh: : 有你，是啊。但你不一样。Imani 就像……妹妹什么的。只不过她跟我完全是不同种族，而且我还想跟她来一场天崩地裂的性爱。

lines.en: : I’m just not the right person for her. If it was purely physical, I’d be able to look past it. But I think that ship has sailed. And I don’t want to lead her on.
lines.zh: : 我只是不是适合她的那个人。如果纯粹是肉体关系，我能看开。但我觉得那条船已经开走了。而我不想吊着她。

lines.en: : Is that enough? Can we go back to talking about you and your sexual orientation again?
lines.zh: : 够了吗？我们能回去聊你和你的性取向了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou18
: {i}Hah...{/i}Of course the {i}one{/i} thing you’d be mature about is the one thing that will wind up hurting someone else who’s close to me.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}当然，你唯一成熟的一件事，恰恰是那件最终会伤到另{i}一个{/i}跟我亲近的人的事。

lines.en: : I’d only hurt her more if I took your advice.
lines.zh: : 我要是听了你的建议，只会伤她更深。

lines.en: : I know. You’re right. Which is why I’m not arguing with you and why I am hereby retiring as her wingwoman. I just feel bad for the poor girl as she’s quite smitten for {i}some{/i} ungodly reason.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你是对的。所以我不跟你争，也特此退出，不再当她的红娘。我只是替那可怜的姑娘难过，不知她着了{i}什么{/i}魔，迷恋得这么深。

lines.en: : Yeah. People just kind of fall for me like that. Maybe it really is the penis thing after all?
lines.zh: : 是啊。大家就是会这样迷上我。也许真的是因为那根阴茎？

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou19
: On that note, how the absolute {i}fuck{/i} did you wind up bagging an idol? And Kumon-mi’s darling, no less.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你{i}他妈{/i}到底是怎么泡到一个偶像的？而且还是 Kumon-mi 的宠儿。

lines.en: : She’s my childhood friend. And the first girlfriend I ever had. And also maybe the last? It’s kind of complicated.
lines.zh: : 她是我的青梅竹马。也是我第一个女朋友。大概也是最后一个？有点复杂。

lines.en: : So...wait. I know I just said I’d drop this, but now I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 所以……等等。我刚说要放下这个，可我现在糊涂了。

lines.en: : You won’t be with Imani because you care too much about the prospect of harming her. But you {i}will{/i} be with your childhood friend and ex-girlfriend, who plays a {i}much more{/i} significant role in your life?
lines.zh: : 你不跟 Imani 在一起，是因为你太在乎会不会伤到她。可你{i}愿意{/i}跟你的青梅竹马、前女友在一起，而她在你生命里的角色重要{i}得多{/i}？

lines.en: : Are you just...{i}okay{/i} with hurting her?
lines.zh: : 你就……{i}甘心{/i}伤她？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : I’m just in love with her.
lines.zh: : 我只是爱她。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou20
: This is why I’ve never dated a man. You’re all stupid. You could have just said that and put an immediate end to the Imani situation without having to go into such detail.
lines.zh: : 这就是我从来不跟男人约会的原因。你们全都蠢。你本来可以直接说这句，Imani 的事立刻就了结了，根本不用讲这么细。

lines.en: : You wanted me to talk, so I talked. This is your fault.
lines.zh: : 你要我说，我就说了。这怪你。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou1
: So the beast {i}can{/i} feel love after all.
lines.zh: : 原来这头野兽也{i}会{/i}爱啊。

lines.en: : I’m not sure how I feel about being called a “beast.”
lines.zh: : 被叫成「野兽」我不知道该怎么想。

lines.en: : Apologies for my hesitance in calling you “human.” I just have a hard time believing you actually {i}are{/i} one after how long I had to listen to your childhood friend cry out in pleasure the other night.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我不太愿意叫你「人类」。我只是很难相信你真{i}是{/i}人类——毕竟前两天晚上我被迫听了你那位青梅竹马多久的愉悦叫喊。

lines.en: : Yeah...sorry about that. And also, sorry for her trying to rope you two into it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那事抱歉。还有，抱歉她想把你俩也拉进去。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou20
: My one chance to sleep with a celebrity...squandered by moral obligations and my previously mentioned unflappable loyalty.
lines.zh: : 我唯一一次睡到名人的机会……被道德义务和我前面提到的不可动摇的忠诚给浪费了。

lines.en: : You do realize I would have been involved too, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我也得参与进去吧？

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou3
: It’s not unusual for there to be a little suffering on the way to making your dreams come true. Your inclusion would simply be me “taking one for the team.”
lines.zh: : 在通往梦想成真的路上受点罪并不稀奇。你的参与不过是我「为团队牺牲一下」。

lines.en: : Unfortunately for {i}all{/i} of us, Osako matters to me far too much to do something like that. So I will put her best interests at heart and just pretend none of it ever happened.
lines.zh: : 可惜对我们{i}所有{/i}人来说，Osako 对我太重要了，我做不出那种事。所以我会把她的最大利益放在心上，就当这一切从没发生过。

lines.en: : But...just to clarify, {i}you’d{/i} be okay with it?
lines.zh: : 不过……确认一下，{i}你{/i}其实不介意？

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou9
: With what? Having a threesome with an extraordinarily attractive celebrity? Of course I’d be okay with it. That’s a once in a lifetime opportunity.
lines.zh: : 介意什么？跟一个格外有魅力的名人三人行？我当然不介意。那是一辈子的机会。

lines.en: : You don’t think that interferes with your {i}love{/i} or anything?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得那会干扰你的{i}爱{/i}情什么的？

lines.en: : I am of the opinion that true love {i}is{/i} letting your significant other have sex with a celebrity because, again, come on.
lines.zh: : 我的看法是，真爱{i}就是{/i}让你的另一半跟名人上床，因为，再说一次，拜托。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou7
: But...that is {i}not{/i} how Osako thinks. And her thoughts and feelings are just as important as mine. If not even {i}more{/i} important.
lines.zh: : 但……那{i}不{/i}是 Osako 的想法。而她的想法和感受跟我的一样重要。甚至{i}更{/i}重要。

lines.en: : Regardless — I thank your childhood friend for the offer, congratulate you on being human enough to love someone, and pity Imani more than I already {i}have{/i} been for her despicable taste in men.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样——我谢谢你的青梅竹马的好意，祝贺你还够人类、能爱上一个人，并且比我{i}之前{/i}更同情 Imani——为她那恶劣到家的男人品味。

lines.en: : Busy night for you, huh? This is probably the most you’ve had to think since college.
lines.zh: : 今晚你够忙的啊？这大概是你大学毕业以后想得最多的一次了。

lines.en: : That’s not true at all. My mind was absolutely {i}flooded{/i} by complicated thoughts after that one time I overdosed and wound up in the hospital while you completely ignored my existence.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。有一次我嗑药过量进了医院，之后脑子里全是被各种复杂的念头{i}淹没{/i}，而你那会儿完全无视我的存在。

lines.en: : Wakana, it’s been years. It’s time to move past that.
lines.zh: : Wakana，那都过去好几年了。该往前看了。

lines.en: : It’s not been {i}years,{/i} Arakawa. Years would imply that-
lines.zh: : 不是{i}好几年{/i}，荒川。好几年意味着——

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou21
: Wakana?
lines.zh: : Wakana？

lines.en: : Are you-
lines.zh: : 你是——

lines.en: : Shh. I’m thinking.
lines.zh: : 嘘。我在想事情。

lines.en: scene wakanatreatsyou22
: Are you familiar with Ecclesiastes 3:1-8?
lines.zh: : 你熟悉传道书 3:1-8 吗？

$ wakana_love += 1
{i}Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Wakana 的好感度提升到了 [wakana_love]！{/i}
